+def _language_name_aliases() -> dict[str, set[str]]:
+    """English and native names for ISO-639-1 codes covered by the MARC map."""
+    aliases: dict[str, set[str]] = {}

+def _language_code_from_site_name(names_to_match: set[str]) -> str | None:
+    """Look up names and ISO codes recorded on Open Library language records."""
+    site = web.ctx.site
+    keys = site.things({'type': '/type/language', 'limit': 1000})
+    matches = set()
+    for language in site.get_many(keys):
+        if language.get('deprecated'):
+            continue
+        names = [language.get('name')]
+        translated_names = language.get('name_translated') or {}
+        for locale in translated_names:
+            names.extend(translated_names[locale])
+        identifiers = language.get('identifiers', {})
+        iso_codes = identifiers.get('iso_639_1', [])
+        if any(
+            _normalized_language_name(candidate) in names_to_match
+            for candidate in (*names, *iso_codes)
+            if candidate
+        ):
+            matches.add(language.code)
+    return next(iter(matches)) if len(matches) == 1 else None
